summary: The previous-release archive test now expects the one difference blob bytes in their own file (#6894) makes: this build's archive header no longer lists blobs, so a release that digests blobs reports a different graph root and no projection match for that table alone, while every other table restores to the same digest

schema.detail: No database, claim or API change.

compatibility.detail: Unchanged behaviour, now stated: the previous release restores this build's archive, with every table but blobs at the same digest. Its report says projections_match false because it digests blobs, which this build leaves out of the projection digest since #6894.
